acquisition.method: Runtime GraphQL introspection against the official v2.4.2366 jar

serverConfig.purpose: Schema extraction only; isolated temporary data directory; no user data

reproduction.note: No credentials are required. Use a throwaway data directory and default NONE auth.
commands:
printf 'server {
  ip = "127.0.0.1"
  port = 4567
  initialOpenInBrowserEnabled = false
  systemTrayEnabled = false
  webUIEnabled = false
  kcefEnabled = false
  authMode = NONE
}
' > "$TMPDIR/suwayomi-baseline/data/server.conf"
java -Djava.awt.headless=true -Dsuwayomi.tachidesk.config.server.rootDir="$TMPDIR/suwayomi-baseline/data" -jar "$TMPDIR/Suwayomi-Server-v2.4.2366.jar" # run in a separate terminal
mkdir -p "$TMPDIR/suwayomi-schema-tool" && cd "$TMPDIR/suwayomi-schema-tool" && npm init -y && npm install --save-exact graphql@16.11.0
# Save the script from reproduction.script as "$TMPDIR/suwayomi-schema-tool/introspect.mjs"
cd - # return to the repository root
